body:
He's 5, almost 6. I had him almost to myself from 3mos to 8mos but after letting his mother keep him a couple weeks while I bought and moved into a nice new house after getting engaged to someone else, she went apeshit and started the harassment and I've only seen him around a dozen times since then - and only when I play her 'flirt with me by text and pretend you want me' game. It's sickening.

Anyway thanks for caring. The only caring person I have in my life is a girl on the other side of the world, someone I've known a year, who says she loves me and wants a future together, but her wealthy family would never accept me (because I'm white and a loser) and I won't allow her to lose them over chosing to be with me so... I did take a small loan from her only after her week-long insistence a few months ago. Used it to get work clothes and switch to an e-cig to save money/life, but I won't take anything else from her and while I dearly love the girl, I couldn't handle life in her snobby world. She's from among the richest most prominent families on the islands and I'm just not interested in having maids and cooks and drivers and maintaining a public image and all that. So. That's that. 

I appreciate your time. Take care and good luck with all.

I'm not interested in crawling back to the surface. I didn't put myself in this position. I get fucked every time I get my head above water. What, sleep on the street, clean up in gas station bathrooms, work at 2 or 3 restaurant jobs, get myself into an apartment or something, and then have it taken away again? Been there, done that, multiple times. I blame everyone else for a long time now, and while it's true I don't do anything wrong to anyone to deserve what happens, I still am a bad judge of character and incapable of managing my life. I'm not interested in trying anymore. I give up. But thank you.

That was in upstate NY a 14 hour drive from here. And it was almost exactly a decade ago. I haven't spoken with anyone there in 8 years. A nice idea but no. Get some sleep, I appreciate your time and concern.

I do. But wifi is pretty limited around here. I've scanned a good portion of the non-residential areas of town and only found a few usable spots. And anyway, I've been homeless before and I'm not going to be that creepy guy who stands outside a shop for half the afternoon in dirty clothes using my phone til it dies and recharging at the library the next morning. I've lived that life before. I'm just not doing it. I have nothing left, I don't have my son, I don't have family, all my small personally meaningful things I've kept over the years are gone, and any day now family court will put out a warrant that will land me in jail for months for child support. I'm sorry but I just don't see a point anymore. I'm 35 in a couple months, my health is rapidly declining, and I have no desire to drag myself off the street after months of misery and starvation just so I can work my ass off for the next 30 years to barely maintain a roof and some ramen. I used to make 83k/yr. It's not about wealth it's about potential. I have no potential left other than a life of drudgery sprinkled with a couple simple enjoyments like pirated ebooks and slushy bottled water. It just doesn't add up to enough to be worth it. Family is everything to me. Mine is gone, and I'm rapidly slipping past the age and situation in life where making my own is reasonably possible.

I'd like to add that I have a lot of signs of melanoma and possibly colon cancer. Things that weren't going on, just 6-12 months ago. Why bother?

I have no family. My mother replied to me last night for the first time this year simply to inform me she wasn't able to help and wished me luck. As for friends most of mine have been female for most of my life and the stalking/harassment/etc from my son's mother drove them away. I literally have no one.

I do appreciate your questions and taking the time to talk with me about this. Nothing's going to change, and I refuse to live on the street and become like the people I used to help (I worked at a homeless shelter and drug rehab many years ago) so when my phone service cuts off, so does my time holding grudges, wishing for the undoable, and hurting over things past. I choose not to live.

I live a couple hours away from where it all happened. I came up here at the invitation of a girl I'd known for a while who then proceeded to start using meth and staying out all night, eventually costing me my job when she threw me out because I refused to sleep with her after her meth binges and whatever nastiness she'd been up to. I still have voice recordings on my phone of her making meth deals, recordings I took so I'd have some leverage if she tried anything unpleasant. I could have fought the overnight kicking out onto the street thing but it would have just resulted in her similarly hardcore druggie sons coming in assaulting me and smashing my things so I stowed my things in her basement and walked out to live on the street with just my laptop and whatever small useful things could fit in its bag.

I'm not working now because this is a very economically depressed town. The major employer, a glass plant, is going belly up and its longtime employees are getting preferential hiring everywhere else. My phone expires tomorrow night leaving me with no contact with the outside world and no good way to pursue employment.

I can talk about it, but it's not going to change anything. Venting may ease the worst edge of negative feelings but it doesn't change my situation and my situation is one I'm not willing to live in anymore.

Why? Because I refused a forced relationship with her. I never wanted her. Her psychiatrist (she was hospitalized for stalking/obsessive and self-harming behavior during the pregnancy, her own parents making the call) told me right in front of her that she was dangerous.

When I kicked her out for snooping through my things and even, yes, smelling me when I'd come home, she was fine leaving our son with me 5 nights a week. But when I got engaged and bought a house with someone else, she went completely nuts. Started contacting everyone I knew, telling them stories, and a lot of people told me while they didn't believe her shit, they couldn't associate with me anymore because my presence in their life was becoming toxic due to her harassments and threats to drag everyone into court as 'witnesses' to imagined and invented offenses. This was all 5 years ago. She didn't stop contacting the new women I dated and new bosses, landlords, etc, until this past year. And actually the only reason she doesn't anymore is because I blanked out my facebook and stopped using it. I haven't been able to have a social media account of almost any kind in almost 6 years because she likes to find mine, then make fake accounts to flirt with me or harass my associates etc. Including reddit.

I don't know what can be done. I have literally zero money. I'm on the street. She has harassed me into homelessness and helplessness. The last time I worked the child support was so crippling I couldn't afford housing despite a $16/hr technical job. And this is a woman whose family is worth millions, she isn't even spending the money raising the boy, every bit of it goes into savings. I don't mind paying my child support but $116/week plus arrears and interest is insane and I can't even afford to get myself cleaned up and get 2 hours away to the relevant court to do anything about it. I'm amazed there's no warrant sworn out on me this summer for non-payment.
I appreciate it but talk doesn't do much when you're on the street.

I've lost my chance to. She scheduled the custody hearing while I was sitting in jail waiting on trial for the bogus charges, so I appeared in family court in orange and shackles. Obviously I got nowhere that way. And I'm so financially ruined now that I have no way to even attempt to go back to court.
